items.title_en: Top 10 most powerful passports in 2026: India climbs rankings, Singapore tops list
items.title_zh: 2026年十大最强大护照：印度排名攀升，新加坡位居榜首
items.summary_en: Singapore retains its title as the world's most powerful passport with visa-free access to 193 destinations, while India climbs to 84th place in the October 2026 rankings.
items.summary_zh: 新加坡继续保持世界上最强大护照的称号，可免签前往 193 个目的地，而印度在 2026 年 10 月的排名中攀升至第 84 位。

items.title_en: US high school graduate makes $808,000 a year from 3D-printing side hustle
items.title_zh: 美国高中毕业生通过 3D 打印副业每年赚取 808,000 美元
items.summary_en: Mike Satterlee is a 19-year-old American entrepreneur who went viral for designing the Tactical Reload Can Cooler under his e-commerce company, Cruise Cup.
items.summary_zh: 迈克·萨特利 (Mike Satterlee) 是一位 19 岁的美国企业家，因在其电子商务公司 Cruise Cup 下设计战术重装罐冷却器而走红。

items.title_en: Sourav Joshi Criticised For Asking Wife Avantika To Drink From Pet Dog’s Bowl, Internet Says ‘Utterly Disgusting’
items.title_zh: 苏拉夫·乔希因要求妻子阿凡蒂卡喝宠物狗碗里的水而受到批评，互联网称“极其恶心”
items.summary_en: Sourav Joshi faces backlash after asking wife Avantika Bhatt to drink from their pet dog Oreo’s bowl during a truth-and-dare game, prompting viewers to question the challenge.
items.summary_zh: 苏拉夫·乔希 (Sourav Joshi) 在一场真心话大冒险游戏中要求妻子阿凡蒂卡·巴特 (Avantika Bhatt) 喝宠物狗奥利奥碗里的水后遭到强烈反对，这促使观众对这一挑战提出质疑。

items.title_en: Viral Video: Paan Vendor Prepares 25 Paans On Lower Berth Of 3AC Train Coach, Raises Hygiene Concerns
items.title_zh: 病毒视频：Paan 供应商在 3AC 火车车厢下铺准备 25 个 Paan，引发卫生问题
items.summary_en: The vendor was seen sitting on the lower berth with his makeshift workstation that featured a cloth spread over the berth and other necessary ingredients to prepare paans
items.summary_zh: 有人看到摊贩坐在下铺，他的临时工作站上铺着一块布，还有其他准备煎饼的必要原料。
